class: Suggestions filterable by country only through a hand-typed address, and time-window chips that silently drop it
fix: One GET filter row: country select (only countries with live 60+ suggestions, names from reference/geo.json), company search (LIKE wildcards escaped), minimum-score select, workplace select (new remote_only engine filter); the time-window chips keep every other filter via kept_params; an active filter shows a summary line with Clear, and the empty state says 'No jobs match those filters'. Plain GET, so no-JavaScript filters identically.
prevention: Every server filter gets a visible control in the same change, and every navigation control preserves its sibling filters.
root_cause: The route read ?country= but rendered no control for it, and the window chips linked to bare ?within= addresses; company_like and min_score had engine support with no route wiring, and workplace had only a client-side chip.
site: Suggested-jobs filter row, web_ui.py + job_discovery.py + geo_reference.py + static/cockpit.css, 3 November 2026
symptom: Filtering suggestions by country meant typing ?country= by hand, and touching a time window silently cleared it; company, score and workplace could not narrow the list from the page at all.
why_tests_missed: Country tests passed hand-built addresses and asserted the query, never that the page offered the filter or that its links preserved it.
